# Glass

> Glass is a free, low-latency remote desktop for macOS. Install it on a Mac, then see and control that Mac from a browser on an iPad, iPhone, or another computer. Typical latency is 15–30 ms from screen capture to display, including over Tailscale. Nothing to install on the viewing device.

Install on the Mac to be controlled: `curl -fsSL getglass.lol | sh` (macOS 13+, Apple Silicon or Intel). The installer starts `glass setup`, a guided setup for Tailscale, the background service and permissions. Viewers need only a browser (Safari 26.4+, Chrome, Edge, Firefox). Free.

## Docs

- [Full documentation](https://getglass.lol/llms-full.txt): everything in one file: install, setup, features, keyboard behaviour on iPad, CLI reference, architecture, security, troubleshooting, FAQ
- [Documentation (HTML)](https://getglass.lol/docs): the same, as a web page
- [Install script](https://getglass.lol/install.sh): what `curl -fsSL getglass.lol | sh` runs

## Optional

- [Feedback API](https://getglass.lol/docs.md#feedback): `POST https://getglass.lol/api/feedback` with JSON `{"message": "…"}`
